metadata.question: Has the nighttime light intensity in Houston decreased on May 18, 2024, compared to the average intensity in April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) data - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" for monthly composites - Need April 2024 average and May 18, 2024 data - Location: Houston, Texas (approximately -95.3698° W, 29.7604° N) 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime lights don't need cloud masking in the traditional sense - The monthly composite already filters out data affected by stray light, lightning, lunar illumination, and cloud cover - We should check for valid data availability 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Nighttime lights can legitimately be 0 in some areas - Compare May 18, 2024 single-day value vs April 2024 monthly average - Note: VIIRS monthly composites are monthly, not daily. We need to use daily data or the closest monthly composite - Should use VIIRS DNB daily or the May 2024 monthly composite since we can't get exactly May 18 - Actually, monthly composites are the standard product. For May 18 specifically, we'd need daily data which may not be readily available in GEE - Let's use May 2024 monthly composite vs April 2024 monthly composite as a proxy ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Houston geometry const houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000); // 20km radius around Houston // 2. Try to get VIIRS monthly nighttime lights data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'); // April 2024 average const april2024 = viirs .filterDate('2024-04-01', '2024-05-01') .filterBounds(houston) .select('avg_rad'); // May 2024 (as proxy for May 18, 2024) const may2024 = viirs .filterDate('2024-05-01', '2024-06-01') .filterBounds(houston) .select('avg_rad'); const aprilSize = april2024.size().getInfo(); const maySize = may2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2024 images: ${aprilSize}`); console.log(`May 2024 images: ${maySize}`); // 3. Check if data exists if (aprilSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { console.log("No data available for comparison period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean nighttime light intensity const aprilImg = april2024.mean(); const mayImg = may2024.mean(); // 5. Reduce to get statistics const aprilStats = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mayStats = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const aprilMean = aprilStats.avg_rad_mean; const aprilCount = aprilStats.avg_rad_count; const mayMean = mayStats.avg_rad_mean; const mayCount = mayStats.avg_rad_count; console.log(`April 2024 mean intensity: ${aprilMean}, pixels: ${aprilCount}`); console.log(`May 2024 mean intensity: ${mayMean}, pixels: ${mayCount}`); // 6. Validation if (aprilCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (aprilMean === null || mayMean === null || isNaN(aprilMean) || isNaN(mayMean) || aprilMean < 0 || mayMean < 0) { console.log("Invalid calculation results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Compare and answer const decreased = mayMean < aprilMean; const percentChange = ((mayMean - aprilMean) / aprilMean * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}% (May vs April)`); if (decreased) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
